title: Roofer Invoice Template
subtitle: An invoice pre-filled for roofing work — repairs, shingle replacement per square, flashing, gutters, skylights and debris removal. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Net 14 — payment due within 14 days. Workmanship guaranteed for 5 years on installed shingles.
notes: Thank you for your business. Roof warranty per manufacturer terms; labor warranty as stated on the invoice.
features: Auto-calculating tax formulas in Excel (just enter your state rate)
Pre-filled roofing line items: repairs, shingle replacement per square, flashing, gutters
License # field — most states require a roofing license on client invoices
Warranty terms printed on the invoice keep claims clear

faqs.q: What should I include on a roofer invoice?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name and license number, the client and job-site address, a dated line-item list (repairs, shingle replacement by square, flashing, gutters), tax, and a total due. Note the warranty terms so clients know what is covered.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate tax automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantity and rate per line, and the subtotal, tax and total update automatically. Leave the tax rate blank if you are not required to charge sales tax.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your contractor board and a CPA or attorney before use.
